thesis: The reviewed business-design passages value easier operation and defensible differentiation while acknowledging cost.
summary: Selected passages discuss cash-flow benefits over time, operational simplicity, and barriers that can make entry harder for competitors. They also note that a capital-intensive asset can require substantial investment. This note does not reconstruct all five advantages from the automatic guide or validate the source's profitability claims.

insights.title: Allow time for a more attractive operating model to develop
insights.explanation: The creator explicitly says the desired business takes time to build. This qualifies the framing of a perfect business as an immediate choice.

insights.explanation: The power-plant example mentions both possible profitability and large capital needs. A moat is not automatically cheap or sufficient.
